evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of perioperative cardiovascular risk before planned
elective total knee arthroplasty.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 74 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 185 ms, QRS 81 ms, QTc
431 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythhm with no acute ST-T wave changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
30%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Severely reducedleft ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 181 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 78 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 70 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 165 mg/dL (H)

BASIC MEETABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 140 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.5 mmol/L
Chloride: 100 mmol/L
CO2: 23 mmol/L
BUN: 9 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 143 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.2 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: suupple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.
